name: Bankable Scheme
benefit: - Loan assistance up to ₹2,00,000/- for businesses, industries, and service activities. - Maximum loan of ₹1,00,000/- for business and ₹1,00,000/- for the industry/service sector individually. - Subsidy of 50% of the loan amount or up to ₹50,000/-, whichever is lower.
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant must be from a scheduled caste. 1. The applicant must be a permanent resident of Gujarat. 1. The applicant's age must be between 18 to 60 years. 1. The applicant must be unemployed. 1. The applicant must be capable of undertaking business activity**.**1. The applicant must not be a defaulter of any financial institution. 1. The applicant's annual income must not exceed ₹1,50,000/- (if residing in urban area) and ₹1,20,000/- (if residing in rural area).
